t: Holts easy-rinse Shampoo and Wax delivers professional car cleaning performance with every wash. Its dual-action formula cuts through stubborn dirt while being gentle on paintwork, leaving a deep, lasting shine. The added wax layer protects bodywork against grime and weather, keeping vehicles cleaner for longer. Designed for consistent, streak-free results whether used by hand or with a pressure washer, this long-lasting 5-litre bottle provides over 300 washes.
b: Gentle on Paintwork, Tough on Dirt
